'''Caretaker droid''' was a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] designed by the [[unidentified Iokath species]] to tend to the artificial world of [[Iokath]]. The species went extinct following the [[Iokath Civil War]], and their [[Caretaker droid/Legends|caretaker droids]] were repurposed by [[ARIES]] into the combat units, aggressive to any intruders.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Caretaker droids appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as enemies on Iokath.
